MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON ________________ 
 
 Present 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Chief Executive / Director 
 Adil Ahmad Kamal Director 
 
 Adil Ahmad Kamal chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AMENDMENT TO THE LOAN AGREEMENT WITH ZAMEEN ARCS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to amend the loan agreement dated 4 April 2019, as amended from time to time (“ Loan Agreement ”), by and between Zameen Arcs (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”) and the Company. 
 
 The Amendment involves converting the amount of the Credit Limit utilized during the term of the Loan Agreement , i.e., Rs. 395,798,222 (“ Loan Amount ”), into 9,800 ordinary shares of the Borrower (“ Shares ”). The issuance of these Shares will constitute full and final settlement of the Loan Amount and fully dispose of all claims and liabilities of the Borrower with respect to or arising under the Loan Agreement. 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Adil Ahmad Kamal , Director of the Company, to discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved , that the Company agrees to amend the Loan Agreement to convert the Loan Amount of Rs. 395,798,222 into 9,800 ordinary shares of the Borrower , with the issuance of such Shares to the Company constituting full and final settlement of the Loan Amount and fully disposing of all claims and liabilities of the Borrower with respect to or arising under the Loan Agreement. 
 
 Resolved further , that Adil Ahmad Kamal be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds, and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction, including but not limited to the execution of the Amendment to the Loan Agreement and the issuance of the Shares in accordance with applicable laws.
